view: Teotihuacan view southward from Pyramid of Moon lower terrace along Avenue of Dead, Pyramid of Sun broad stepped pyramid correctly on left east side of avenue, receding low platform courts, dry Valley of Mexico hills; no Maya roof combs or temples atop surviving pyramids.

eras.title: Down the avenue
eras.caption: The Avenue of the Dead gives Teotihuacan a clear north–south axis. From the raised platforms, its stepped monuments and repeated courtyards reveal a planned city whose influence reached far beyond the Valley of Mexico.
